data.name: Jaspal
data.gender_notes: Jaspal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaspal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jas', meaning 'gold' and 'Paal', meaning 'treasure'. In Hindu mythology, Jaspal represents the divine treasure of knowledge and wisdom. The name is often associated with the god of wealth, Kubera, and is believed to bring prosperity and abundance. The name Jaspal carries the meaning “God's Treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaspal usually hope their child will grow to embody god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Jaspal Suri, a 16th century Sikh warrior and politician who served under the Mughals, was given the title 'Jaspal Singh' by the Mughal Emperor Akbar in recognition of his bravery and loyalty.
